description: A dark, rainy oil painting of a large crowd of young men in white short-sleeved shirts and dark trousers linking arms and snake-dancing down a wet street. Banners, flags and placards are held up, with Japanese-style brush characters on a white banner at left. A domed, stepped government building resembling the National Diet Building sits behind under stormy, smoky skies. Mid-20th-century feel, no frame.
reason: The large white banner at upper left carries clearly painted kanji-like brush characters, so there is painted-in text. Repaint with blank banners and placards.
